full_name: Tulasi Srinivas | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
bio: Tulasi Srinivas, an associate professor of anthropology at Emerson College, studies global and transnational cultural anthropology, with a special focus on the political economy and religion in urban India. Her research addresses the complexities of religious creativity in post-liberalism India.
